tetapi tidak perlu khawatir.

Hasilnya sempurna! 🙆🏻‍♀️🙆🏻‍♀️🙆🏻‍♀️🙆🏻‍♀️

en-US.description:
A cushion that stays matte even when you sweat 🥹

While giving makeup lessons, I noticed that those who insist on a matte finish always prefer drying out their skin completely...?

You mentioned that you were concerned about your base makeup becoming too thick and cakey, so I’m here to recommend #HERA #BlackCushionMeshPowder as the solution..❤︎

The skin feels incredibly light, and the blurry, matte finish is so beautiful.

★But the biggest feature is that it lasts a long time★

For those with oily skin, the matte finish usually disappears quickly even when you apply powder over a cushion, right?

But I was surprised because this really keeps the matte finish intact...

It doesn't feel dry or stiff; I'd say it feels soft and bouncy..💗

Since it's a powder type, I was worried it might clump if I applied concealer and cream blush on top,

but there's no need to worry.

It works perfectly! 🙆🏻‍♀️🙆🏻‍♀️🙆🏻‍♀️🙆🏻‍♀️

Perfect for when you want to add a glow to your cheeks while doing light and quick makeup! ⌲ Apply cream blush over mesh powder

⌲ No need for extra powder on nasolabial folds or T-zone

When you want a completely matte finish and add a glow with highlighter!

⌲ Apply regular powder blush over mesh powder

⌲ Apply highlighter liberally..❤

⌲ No need for extra powder︎

19:29 과감한 하이라이터 조아하시는 분~!


☆. 。. : *・ °☆｡ ✦ + . ｡☆ﾟ: ;｡ +ﾟ†


*등장제품*
① #토코보 시카 카밍 세럼
쫀득한 광채가 오래 남는편이 아닌 산뜻하고 흡수 빠른 진정 제품이라

② #연작 백년초 수분 진정크림
너무 꾸덕하지도 너무 묽지도 않는 적당한 텍스쳐의 크림인데
빠르게 수분을 잠가주기에 되게 좋더라구요!

갈웜분들 무조건 사야해....

④ #자빈드서울 윙크 아이 쉐이드 프라이머 01
말모 메이크업 시작 전 기본으로 깔고 시작합니당

⑤ #홀리카홀리카 마이페이브 피스 젤테일 코코아 브륄레
아이라이너 써보고 싶긴한데 섀도우가 편하다면 이걸로 써보세요!
짱짱편하고 좋아요!

메이크업에 재미(?)를 넣고 싶다면 요 컬러로 애교살 음영 넣어보세요 큭큭

ㄱㄱㅑ 이 색 너무 이뻐요;; 진심 존예 너무 이쁨 빨리 사세요 ㅠ
너무 글로시하지 않고 약간 포슬하게 발려서 베이스 까짐이 없어요!
은은한 펄감까지 존예인 멀멀 누디한 컬러..❤︎

⑧ #포트레 블러 핏 파우더 치크 로지 샌드
섀딩이랑 연결감있게 바르기 너무너무 좋은 제품이에요!
저처럼 블러셔 여러가지 쓰시는 분들은 꼭 써보세요

아악 이거 색도 너무 이쁘고,
들어있는 펄이 너무 튀지 않으면서 진짜 이쁘더라구요,, 완전히 영록

①⓪ #맥 스쿼트 플럼핑 글로스 스틱 '시뮬레이션
요 라인 중에 제일 좋아하는 컬러감인데

You absolutely must buy one of today's recommended items...
That's the secret to quitting the nomadic lifestyle and saving your wallet this year..⭐︎

Products that were featured in the previous video but not in this one
are briefly listed in the More section. 🫶🏻

🕊️ *Looking for someone who'd like to try a radiant, paid filter* 🕊️
Event Item: #Yeonjak Skin Perfecting Glow Prep Base
Number of Winners: 10
Event Period: January 12th - January 18th
Winner Announcement: January 19th
How to Participate: Leave a comment about the prep base to automatically enter! _I'll leave a personal comment for the winner!_

*Timeline*
00:00 Intro
00:51 [Re-appearance] A built-in base product I've been using for N bottles
04:53 I was like, "Why isn't this available?" and here it is;; Paid filter base product
09:46 [Re-appearance] I've tried everything else, but this one is the best! Powder is the best after all
14:32 There are times when you need it. Porcelain cushion vs. moisturizing cushion base product
17:45 The time-saving shade product recommended several times in the video
19:59 I keep reaching for it~🎶 Blusher product

✧･ﾟ: ✧･ﾟ: 　_Product Featured_　 :･ﾟ✧:･ﾟ✧

❶ *#Yeonjak Skin Perfecting Protective Base Prep*
https://content.29cm.co.kr/post/68186
☑️ _Re-appearance item! A must-have item from now on_

⚠️ *Note*
Apply all over your face, then sweep once with your entire palm!
→ This will smooth out your skin and create a thin, even layer.
After applying, apply prep base or foundation immediately!
→ This will help the next step to be thin and even.

🍯 *Honey tip not shown in the video*
If you forgot to apply foundation right away...

Mix the base prep and foundation together for the second layer~^0^

❷ *#Yeonjak Skin Perfecting Glow Prep Base*
https://content.29cm.co.kr/post/68186
☑️ _New item! I was looking for a foundation that combined tone-up, pore control, and UV protection, and this one was released last year and I've been using it ever since.

⚠️ *Note*
It feels a bit heavy at first, but if you apply it slowly and gently, it will spread evenly.
(Don't try to blend it quickly XXX)
If you're using this alone without foundation, finish with powder!

🍯 *Tip not shown in the video*
This product fills in unevenness and tone-up for a flawless complexion, so it's perfect for the neck!!!!!
I have pigmentation and unevenness on my neck, which is a huge concern, and this one solved my problem.
Pump once on the back of your hand, apply it to your face, and then apply the remaining amount to your neck. 🫶🏻

❸ *#Hera Airy Powder Primer*
☑️ _Re-appearing item! This is a product I'll definitely be using from now on.

⚠️ *Note*
This powder is originally supposed to be used as a primer before base makeup,
but in my last post, I recommended using it after base makeup rather than before.

I still end up using it after base makeup... If I use it before, my base makeup ends up cakey. ㅠ

🍯 *Information not shown in the video*
I often forget to wash the included brush because I only use it for touch-ups.

But if I blot it on a paper towel, it removes any cakey residue and leaves a clean finish!

❹ *#Mac Studio Fix Longwear Cushion Foundation (I have a shade 22, I use shade N18)*
☑️ _New item! Here's when it's needed_

⚠️ *Caution*
This product sets quickly and hardens like paint once set, so precise and quick application is key.
For an even application, gently tap the puff with your fingertips, making a "tapping" sound.

🍯 *Tip not shown in the video*
Because it has such a matte finish, it can look cakey.
But when used with the Yeonjak Base Prep, it creates a really beautiful, long-lasting effect.

❺ *#TirTir Mask Fit Ruby Mesh Cushion*
☑️ _First appearance! Here's when it's needed_

⚠️ *Caution*
This product is moisturizing yet offers high coverage, so applying it thickly can be greasy.

It's important to apply it little by little to find the right amount!

🍯 *Tips not shown in the video*
I mentioned in the video that this is recommended for people who frequently visit the dermatologist, but I didn't explain why.
It contains PDRN essence, so I recommend it to those who frequently receive dermatological treatments!

❻ *#HeartPercent Dot On Mood Gel Eyeliner Pencil No. 4*
☑️ _First appearance! But this product was also recommended in lesson content and beginner content._
